# TITLE-CANARY-9ab77e-the-betrayal

A rule the group wrote for the table and then decided to keep between them. It
carries no `system:` beyond the one that keeps it filed, and it is the fixture's
private rule: the matrix gives it to the DM alone, so every assertion about it is
a two-polarity one — present for the principals that may open it, absent for the
ones that may not.

Its title is the canary the tests look for. A page title is public text — it is
in the file tree, the tag cloud, the command palette and every backlink — which
is exactly why this file exists: it is what a page looks like when the *page* is
private, and the index must reflect the store's answer rather than its own guess
about who is asking.
